$comment: p15-oracle-081: tuning of the remaining small action families, every non-excluded id of plans/cmux-next/action-surfaces.json whose family_of in scripts/cmux-next/oracle/gen_actions.py is misc (a prefix no other family names: window, app, bookmark, notification, history, checklist, vault, server and the rest; 224 ids today, the design's ~169 runnable plus the 55 every-action-gaps.json gaps that p15-oracle-082..087 close). gen_actions.py (p15-oracle-071) reads this file (load_tuning: only $comment and actions; each spec's keys in TUNING_KEYS) and keeps regeneration byte-stable. Each of the 169 entries was read against its handler in Packages/macOS/CmuxNext/Sources/CmuxNextApp. Legacy bind/run/invoke handlers report action.done, bindEffect intent handlers action.applied. A case without `entry` runs the action's single-stroke shortcut through debug.key when it has one and needs no argument (a person's run: it may change the view); else action.run, a script caller without focus: only ActionCatalog.focusActionIDs change the view, page opens file a tab without focus (/tabs/panes changed), pickers refuse with pickerNeedsFocus, and refusals are control.unavailable (ControlError.actionOutcome; a tracked work's thrown ActionFailure too). A refusal case of a keyed action sets entry action so the typed error is the control's. Settings actions wait on /settings/nonDefaultKeys; one that writes its key's default makes the key non-default in a before step. Not tuned: the 55 gaps (canvas*, diffViewer*, markdown*, fileEditor*, fileExplorer*, omnibar.openIn*, commandPaletteNext/Previous, cycleTextBoxSubmitAction, reconnectPane, saveFilePreview: no fixture yet). The 8 debug-only or destructive ids (openDebugSettings, debug.actionLatencyHUD, debug.blockingCalls.reset, server.makeThisMacAServer, server.stopServing, server.showHealth, taskManager.killProcess, window.stash) stay blocked by the sweep's flags; their tuning keeps the checks for when a flag lifts. A `note` that starts with `divergence <key>` files a finding for routing; the case stays green because the oracle is differential. Chromium: chrome/browser/ui/browser_command_controller_unittest.cc checks each command on its own browser; each case here checks one command on its own fresh session.
